Elon University released a new poll last week showing little change in North Carolina’s approval rating of President Donald Trump as the midterm elections approach.

In March, 55% of North Carolinians disapproved of the job Trump was doing, and the latest poll showed 54% disapproved.

The university polled 800 adult North Carolinians between July 23 and July 31. Ninety-eight percent of those polled said they were likely voters.
